rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"The change stops TypeCollector from indexing DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] when it builds the MemberNeedsKey (field) and BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull (property) diagnostics. A member that comes from metadata has no syntax references, so this indexing threw. It also wraps the analyzer's report callback so that a diagnostic is dropped unless its location is a source tree in the compilation being analyzed. Three new generator tests compile the defining code to a metadata-only image and check two things: that the analyzers and the generator report no diagnostics, and that the resolver source is generated. README and the MsgPack004 doc now say that diagnostics for types from referenced assemblies are reported by the project that defines them.","why":"Issue 2283 (MP-2283): a [MessagePackObject] member typed as a closed generic struct or record struct from a referenced assembly made the generator and the analyzer throw IndexOutOfRangeException.
